payload.title: Custom Menu-key paste layer disrupts the desktop during early implementations

expectation.text: A Menu-key A-to-Z direct-text layer should open a normal editor on a tap and type a selected mapping without trapping focus, destabilizing the compositor, or exposing mapped text in process arguments.

payload.observed: The first custom editor used an exclusive full-screen layer surface and trapped keyboard focus. A later experiment that removed dynamic binding handles destabilized the compositor twice. A redesigned menu plugin with static bindings passed non-physical checks, but final one-tap and mapped-text physical tests remained pending.
